title: Honey to Slime
description: A small resource pack that changes honey-related blocks to have slime block-like textures. It also changes the item names and some subtitle names accordingly.
body:
This resource pack makes all vanilla honey-related items and blocks look like they are made of or full of green slime instead. It also edits the following text in the game to reflect their new appearances:

- Honeycombs are now Combjellies (like the jellyfish!)
- Honeycomb Blocks are now Combjelly Blocks.
- Honey Bottles are now Slime Bottles (you can now eat slime in Minecraft, in case you wanted to do that before but could not. I guess)
- Honey Blocks are now Slimy Blocks (I ran out of ideas. I guess it's not viscous enough to be outright slime?)
- Subtitles for honey dripping and honey block sliding are changed to reflect the item names. 
- While not visually changed, all waxed coppper blocks are renamed to "Slimed" variants. ~~Utter pain in the neck with how many there are~~

Honey and waxing particles are unchanged as that is unfortunately hardcoded. Advancements are unaffected until I figure out how to edit them (if possible)

This pack has French and multiple English (US/GB/CA) language options. The French one may be reworded to be better later as I'm not good at puns in it. If your English variant is missing, you can duplicate either the US or GB .json depending on what spellings you use.

_I do not plan to really maintain this as it is an extremely high-effort joke pack for a server I play on._ I am putting it here for ease of their use.

The license is ARR as I'm not really sure what this falls under. You _can_ credit me for the edits if you want but the original textures are by Jappa and I do not claim otherwise.
